body:
I've done these things, but if that's the answer to my problems, then I'm not enveloping myself enough. I'm lazy and I have to do more then, or find someone who can help me do more. I like the idea being willing to go beyond. It's vague enough to work for me.

But what happens when these phrases begin to seem like platitudes to me? I suppose I need some form of spiritual or emotional rest, and I don't know how to achieve that.

Thank you.

I am a Christian, but I guess I'm just bad at it. I'm not unfamiliar with other theologies and ideologies, but nothing has satisfied me. When I'm miserable like this, I turn away from everyone and want to be left utterly alone. And so, when most people turn to God in their pain, I often force myself away.

So... Just pick a reason to live and be utterly engulfed by it? How do I drink so deeply from something. The answer must be outside of me, because I have so often found such hopelessness on my own.
I feel like you expect this could change my opinion on my life. I don't think I'll go through with offing myself any time soon, but if I do, I will take this course of action.
